gaps.sentence: He denied everything ___ the face of the evidence.
gaps.hint: ___ the face of = when confronted with
gaps.explanation: 'in the face of' = despite / when confronted by.

gaps.sentence: The two reports differ ___ several important respects.
The project is ___ way to completion ahead of schedule.
The smell was ___ this world — absolutely incredible.
The tickets sold out ___ a matter of hours.
gaps.explanation: 'in a matter of hours' = within only a few hours.

gaps.sentence: The company is ___ serious financial difficulties.
___ the circumstances, the committee chose leniency.
The original manuscript is ___ permanent display in Vienna.
gaps.explanation: 'on display' = being shown to the public.
